jei.baublesreborn.info.heart_shard: Dropped rarely by hostile mobs killed by a player; Looting improves the odds. Also found in dungeon, mineshaft, temple, stronghold, mansion, fortress and bastion chests. Four shards make a Crimson Heart.
jei.baublesreborn.info.heart_crimson: Crafted from four Heart Shards, or found occasionally in structure chests. Fills a Red Heart Canister, and is the base of the Gilded Heart.
jei.baublesreborn.info.heart_gilded: A Crimson Heart worked with gold and blaze powder. Also found in Nether fortress, bastion and End city chests. Fills a Yellow Heart Canister, and is the base of the Verdant Heart.
jei.baublesreborn.info.heart_verdant: A Gilded Heart worked with emeralds and eyes of ender. Rarely found in End city chests. Fills a Green Heart Canister.
jei.baublesreborn.info.canister_empty: Does nothing while empty. Combine it with a Crimson, Gilded or Verdant Heart to make a filled canister.
jei.baublesreborn.info.canister_filled: Worn in its own slot of the baubles inventory (right-click to equip). Each filled canister adds 10 max health; one of each colour can be worn.
